ops.body: Root scope/severity judgment on placeholder-layout review: the requested defect is clipping at ordinary narrow split widths shown in two-profile-3 screenshot (~220px). The workflow-added requirement to keep full labels readable at the app absolute minimum50px is not part of the approved task; classify that extreme collapsed-pane limitation as minor, not a release blocker. Do not add a new popup/control interaction solely for50px. Accept the remaining limitation with the normal resize affordance if the pictured narrow-pane labels/buttons now fit. If a small existing-pattern repair is already complete, it can land, but do not start another broad review/test cycle for this. Probe shell-parity is a real functional finding and still needs its bounded fix.
